content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**Fix applied:** the indemnification carve-out in new Section 16.7 now reads "each Party's indemnification obligations under this Agreement (including under Article 10 and Sections 16.1 and 16.2)", so every indemnity source the Agreement recognises — including the Article 10 indemnities that retained 16.5 expressly preserves — sits outside the cap. This also removes the tension whereby Article 10 third-party indemnity payments would have been capped while 16.5 protects them from the damages waiver.

**Final position (fallback):** single inserted Section 16.7 delivering a mutual aggregate cap at 12 months' amounts payable by Ono, with all indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct uncapped. Section 16.5 and all surrounding text remain untouched; preferred-level extras (USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable", data protection/security, fraud, other-party IP, payment-obligations exclusion) are deliberately not claimed.
